sourceTitle: Quick and Easy Brownie Marshmallow Cookies!!!
sourceText:
Quick and Easy Brownie Marshmallow Cookies!!!
By: Lady Catherine ...
Published: Tuesday, February 7, 2012 - 7:32am

Ingredients




1 box of brownie mix
½ cup of all-purpose flour – sifted
½ cup of brown sugar
4 tablespoons butter
1 tsp. vanilla
2 eggs
2 tablespoons water
½ cup of shredded coconut
½ cup marshmallows
½ cup of chocolate chips

Preparation

1 Preheat Oven 350 degrees: 2 In a mix-master place the brown sugar, butter, vanilla and eggs, mix until smooth. Add the flour, brownie mix, water, chocolate chips and marshmallows. Mix until all is incorporated. 3 Place the cookie batter by the teaspoonful on a greased cookie sheet or parchment paper lined cookie pans. 4 Bake 10-12 minutes. Remove the cookies from the baking pan and let them cool on a rack.

About

These cookies are a good treat that make you feel just a little bit guilty.
With Love,
Catherine
xo
